title: Senior SAO Orchestration Architect – Cisco NSO
description:
We are looking for a
 **Senior SAO Orchestration Architect** 
 with 10\+ years of experience in network automation, service orchestration, and telecom/network software engineering. The candidate should have strong hands\-on expertise in
 **Cisco NSO, YANG, Python, NETCONF/RESTCONF, APIs, and cloud\-native technologies** 
 .
   

  

 The role involves architecting and implementing scalable Service Activation and Orchestration solutions, integrating NSO with OSS/BSS, inventory, assurance, SDN controllers, and ITSM platforms, while providing technical leadership to engineering teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and lead Cisco NSO\-based Service Activation and Orchestration solutions.
* Develop scalable YANG models, NSO service packages, templates, and reusable workflows.
* Lead Python\-based network automation and orchestration initiatives.
* Design and implement integrations using REST APIs, NETCONF, RESTCONF, XML, and JSON.
* Integrate Cisco NSO with OSS/BSS, inventory, assurance, SDN controllers, and ITSM systems.
* Define orchestration architecture, standards, governance, and best practices.
* Design and manage microservices and API\-based architectures.
* Deploy and manage containerized orchestration workloads using Kubernetes, OpenShift, and Docker.
* Collaborate with customers and stakeholders on solution architecture and technical design.
* Conduct architecture reviews, estimation, solution planning, and technical discussions.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across development and automation teams.
* Support CI/CD and DevOps practices for network automation solutions.


 Mandatory Skills
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in Network Automation, Service Orchestration, or Telecom Software Engineering.
* Strong hands\-on Cisco NSO architecture and development experience.
* Expertise in YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF, XML, and JSON.
* Advanced Python programming for network automation.
* Strong knowledge of REST APIs, Microservices, and API Gateway integration.
* Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, and Docker.
* Strong networking fundamentals: MPLS, BGP, OSPF, IS\-IS, VPN, Routing \& Switching.
* Good experience with Linux, Git, CI/CD, Jenkins, and DevOps.
* Experience in integrating orchestration platforms with enterprise/network systems.
* Strong architecture, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.


 Good to Have
   

  

* EVPN\-VXLAN, Segment Routing, SDN, and NFV.
* Kafka, Helm, ArgoCD, gRPC, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* AWS, Azure, or GCP networking and automation.
* Experience with Telecom OSS/BSS transformation programs.
* Experience with cloud\-native network orchestration platforms.


 Leadership Expectations
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture and technical delivery.
* Lead architecture and design discussions with customers.
* Drive technical decisions, standards, and best practices.
* Mentor and guide engineering teams.
* Participate in estimation, solutioning, architecture reviews, and technical governance.
* Act as a senior technical point of contact for orchestration and network automation solutions.


 Education \& Certifications
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Preferred certifications: CCIE, Cisco NSO Certification, CKA/CKAD, or Red Hat OpenShift Certification.

title: Lead - Data & AI Platform
description:
**Role:** 
 Lead Data \& AI Platform Engineer
 



**Function:** 
 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

title: Product Engineer (Field Tools)
description:
****Starting Date:****
 December 2026
   

  

****Contract type:****
 Full\-time and open\-ended
   

  

****Salary:****
 From 2,716,737 INR
   

  

****Location:****
 India; Delhi, Ahmedabad (Hybrid)
   

  

****Application closing date:****
 8th October 2026
   

  

**If we receive a high volume of applications, we may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.**
**About The Job**
 The Product Engineer designs and builds the digital products that farmers, field teams, programme partners, and BCI teams rely on to collect data and carry out field activities. The role combines product judgement, design sensibility, and hands\-on software engineering to turn field and programme requirements into simple, reliable products in production. The Product Engineer is key strengthening the quality and usability of Better Cotton's field\-facing digital tools and, in turn, the efficiency of field operations across our programme geographies.
   

  

****The Challenge****
 Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will be responsible for :
   

  

* Review and stress\-test requirements from subject\-matter experts and programme teams, identifying unclear assumptions and unnecessary complexity before build begins.
* Partner with the Product Designer to shape simple, effective user flows for mobile, offline, and multilingual field use.
* Translate agreed solutions into clear, prioritised, testable delivery increments, and build high\-quality features across frontend, backend, and data layers.
* Use AI coding agents throughout prototyping, development, testing, and debugging to accelerate delivery without compromising quality, security, or maintainability.
* Write automated tests and instrument products to track adoption, performance, and reliability in real\-world field conditions.
* Release features safely, support their rollout, and iterate based on field feedback and product usage data.
* Work collaboratively with the line manager to set clear, outcome\-based objectives that align with function\-wide and organisational goals.
* Take ownership of agreed objectives, ensuring alignment with team priorities and performance expectations.


**Experience**
 the following skills, knowledge, and experience:
   

  

**Essential**
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience, with a strong track record of personally building, shipping, and improving production digital products that users value and rely on; evidence of judgement, scope, and delivery matters more than tenure.
* Experience taking products from prototype through production, rollout, and continuous improvement.
* Strong product and interaction\-design judgement, gained working closely with designers and subject\-matter experts.
* Experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of development, testing, debugging, and code review.
* Experience testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production applications.
* Experience with agriculture, field operations, offline products, multilingual interfaces, geospatial workflows, or products for users with varying digital literacy is valuable.
* Experience building modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and related frontend technologies.
* Experience developing backend services, APIs, and databases using Python (or a comparable language), SQL, and cloud\-based infrastructure.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is essential.


**Desirable**
* Proficiency in Hindi, Urdu, Swahili, or other relevant languages would be advantageous.


**What We Offer**
* Hybrid working opportunity, with the office days based in Delhi.
* The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year
* Flexible working, with core hours from 10 am to 4 pm local time
* Continuous learning and development
* Pension scheme
* A generous annual leave package, including paid holiday, public holidays, additional paid days off during the festive season, study and exam days, and extra discretionary leave for life events such as family weddings or moving home
* Enhanced parental benefits
* The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.


****Working arrangements****
 The position is full\-time (40 hours per week) and will be based in Delhi. Better Cotton Initiative offers flexible working, with core hours being 10 am – 4 pm. The position may require limited international travel.
   

  

****Apply now****
 Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1\-page maximum) by or before
 ****08\.10\.2026****
 via the application link.
   

  

 In your cover letter, please include an explanation of why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton Initiative. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.
   

  

 Better Cotton Initiative does not use artificial intelligence or in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human\-led assessment experience.
   

  

****Our hiring process****
**Initial Screening**
 Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicant. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.
   

  

**Interviews**
 If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton Initiative may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management. As an internal candidate, you may have discussions regarding your current responsibilities and how they will transition to the new position.
   

  

**Assessment And Testing**
 Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position. Internal candidates may have the option to demonstrate their existing skills through current job performance or past project outcomes.
   

  

**Reference Checks**
 Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications, and for some roles, your education and criminal history. Internal candidates may be asked for references from current or previous supervisors within Better Cotton Initiative to provide insights into their performance and capabilities.
   

  

**Offer Stage**
 After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If you are selected and your references are relevant and satisfactory, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details. For internal candidates, the offer process may include a discussion about how your transition to the new role will be managed and any support needed for a smooth handover.
   

  

**About Better Cotton Initiative**
 Better Cotton Initiative is a global not\-for\-profit organisation supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand. In just 15 years we have aligned more than a fifth of the world’s cotton with our standard and helped farmers and farming communities thrive. Join us in building a better, more sustainable future for cotton worldwide.
   

  

**About Our Values**
 The post holder will be expected to operate in line with our workplace values which are:
   

  

* Trustworthy (including honest, transparent, credible)
* As having Integrity (including responsible, authentic)
* Positive (including problem\-solving, pragmatic)
* Engaging (including adaptable, inclusive, holistic)
* Daring (including courageous, innovative, game\-changing)


****Being you @ Better Cotton****
****Initiative****
 Better Cotton Initiative is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources.
   

  

 We have a zero\-tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Safeguarding incidents are acts of serious misconduct and are grounds for disciplinary action, up to and including, dismissal and referral to relevant authorities for criminal prosecution. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

title: BRIM Technical Architect
description:
What You'll Do:
   

  

 Own the technical architecture of the SAP BRIM platform — how it is built, integrated, and kept scalable over time. You define how the Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) solution is structured technically: the billing and subscription models at implementation level, the integration architecture, the cross\-module technical coherence, and the extensibility patterns that keep the platform upgrade\-safe and maintainable as Criteo's monetization evolves.
   

  

 Beyond delivery, you are a strategic thinking partner — contributing to the definition of the future billing platform: what monetization capabilities Criteo needs to build, what the platform should become, and how technical architecture choices today shape product options tomorrow.
   

  

 Main missions:
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end technical architecture across BRIM modules, ensuring cross\-module coherence at implementation level (CI, SOM, CM, CC, FI\-CA) within the O2C flow
* Define and own the billing and subscription model implementation: rating architecture, pricing and charging structures, contract and entitlement lifecycle at technical level.
* Own the integration architecture between BRIM, S/4HANA FI and non\-SAP systems — interface contracts, data flows, error handling patterns, API and event\-based integration.
* Ensure the platform remains extensible, upgrade\-safe and Clean Core compliant — define the extensibility patterns (standard APIs, events) that govern how the ABAP Lead builds.
* Translate functional designs into implementable technical blueprints, surfacing constraints, trade\-offs and platform limitations before build starts.
* Partner with the BRIM Product Lead to help defining the future billing platform vision — translating market, business and monetization evolutions into technical architecture directions and platform investment options.


 Tasks:
   

  

* Define the technical implementation of monetization models: subscription structures, rating and pricing mechanics, billing cycle architecture, revenue and collection flows at system level.
* Design integration patterns and interface contracts (inbound/outbound, event\-driven, API\-based) between BRIM and adjacent systems; own technical decisions on error handling, retry, and reconciliation.
* Validate technical feasibility of functional designs produced by the Solution Architect; identify cross\-module technical impacts and escalate conflicts or constraints before they reach build.
* Define extensibility standards and Clean Core guardrails for the ABAP Lead: which enhancement frameworks to use, where custom code is justified, how extensions are structured to remain upgrade\-safe.
* Contribute to BRIM product roadmap discussions with the Product Lead: surface technical constraints, platform opportunities and build\-vs\-standard trade\-offs that shape future product decisions."
* Anticipate evolutions in Criteo's monetization model and translate them into forward\-looking architecture options — new billing constructs, extensibility needs, integration patterns — before they become urgent delivery requirements.
* Provide technical architecture inputs to backlog refinement: effort drivers, implementation options, technical risks, dependency sequencing.
* Produce and maintain the BRIM technical architecture documentation: module interaction model, integration blueprint, master and transactional data architecture, key identifiers across BRIM and S/4HANA.
* Anticipate SAP platform evolutions (S/4HANA releases, BTP where applicable) and maintain a technical roadmap that keeps the BRIM estate extensible and forward\-compatible.
* Lead and contribute to architecture workshops with Solution Architect, ABAP Lead and BRIM components Leads.
* Support delivery teams during complex build, test and hypercare phases on architecture\-level technical issues.


 Who You Are:
   

  

* 8\+ years in SAP architecture and delivery, with deep end\-to\-end ownership of BRIM technical implementations.
* Strong cross\-module expertise in SAP BRIM — with solid working knowledge of SOM, CC, CI and CM integration patterns.
* Proven track record designing and governing billing model architectures: subscription, rating, pricing, invoicing and collection flows at technical implementation level.
* Solid experience defining integration architectures between SAP BRIM / S/4HANA and cloud or non\-SAP systems.
* Strong command of SAP extensibility frameworks (standard APIs, events) and Clean Core principles — able to set the standard others build to.
* Able to translate functional solution designs into technical blueprints and surface implementation constraints before they become delivery risks.
* Ability to think beyond delivery — engaging on product vision, monetization strategy and platform futures with business and product stakeholders, not just with engineering teams.
* Experience working in international, distributed and offshore environments; comfortable aligning remote technical teams to architectural decisions.
* Strong communication skills — able to engage both Business and Engineering stakeholders, and to make architecture trade\-offs legible to non\-architects.


 We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!
   

  

 Who We Are:
   

  

 We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.
   

  

 At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward\-thinking environment.
   

  

 We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non\-job\-related factors or legally protected characteristics.

 🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in\-office experiences, making space for both.

 💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks \& mental health support.
   

  

 🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.
   

  

 💸 Fair pay \& perks – Attractive salary, with performance\-based rewards and family\-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.
   

  

 Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

 NA
   

  

**Minimum 7\.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 AI Powered Tech talent
   

  

**Summary**
 Build AI native, enterprise integration products on SAP BTP Integration Suite by combining strong integration engineering fundamentals with agentic AI patterns (LLMs \+ tools \+ retrieval \+ evaluation). The role focuses on creating and operating production\-grade integrations across cloud, on premise, and hybrid landscapes—while augmenting the integration lifecycle with intelligent capabilities such as automated iFlow generation, mapping recommendations, anomaly detection, predictive operations, and conversational troubleshooting. This role owns AI behavior in the integration layer (grounding, safety, evaluation), not just AI\-assisted development.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Integration Engineering (Cloud, Hybrid, On Prem)


 Design, develop, and run end\-to\-end integration scenarios using cloud integration capabilities, enabling reliable connectivity across SAP and non SAP systems.
   

  

 Build, structure, and manage large integration flows with clear modularity, reusability, and maintainability for enterprise scale.
   

  

* Integration Flow Development (iFlows) \& Message Transformation


 Create and maintain integration flows using routing, splitting, gathering, and other transformation patterns.
   

  

 Implement message mappings and data transformations for common enterprise formats (e.g., JSON, XML, CSV), ensuring semantic correctness and downstream compatibility.
   

  

 Apply canonical modeling and contract\-first practices to reduce brittle point\-to\-point dependencies.
   

  

* Scripting, Persistence \& Advanced Flow Control


 Use scripting (e.g., Groovy) to implement complex transformation logic, enrichment, validation, and conditional execution paths.
   

  

 Implement message persistence patterns (e.g., data stores) to support idempotency, retries, correlation, and resilience.
   

  

* API \& Connector Enablement


 Design and expose secure APIs through API management capabilities (policies, authentication/authorization, throttling, versioning).
   

  

 Integrate with third party applications using connector\-based approaches and standardized integration patterns.
   

  

 Enable event\-driven integration approaches using messaging/event capabilities for near real\-time propagation and decoupled architectures.
   

  

* AI Native Integration Intelligence (Agentic Integration Layer)


 Build integration agents that can generate initial iFlows from system/endpoint selections and naming conventions, then validate them against enterprise standards.
   

  

 Implement retrieval\-grounded assistance that pulls from interface catalogs, mapping specs, standards, runbooks, and known incident patterns to produce verifiable recommendations (no free\-form guessing).
   

  

 Apply intelligent recommendations for mapping and configuration, accelerating build and reducing rework.
   

  

 Develop AI\-driven anomaly detection and prediction for integration/API behavior (error spikes, latency patterns), with human\-in\-the\-loop controls for remediation actions.
   

  

 Optimize and analyze scripts used in integration flows for performance and maintainability through AI\-assisted code analysis techniques.
   

  

* Testing, Quality Engineering \& Evaluation Loops


 Build automated testing strategies for integrations: schema/contract validation, payload regression suites, replay testing, and API testing tool\-driven verification.
   

  

 Implement AI evaluation harnesses (offline golden test sets \+ online monitoring) for generated mappings, generated flows, and operational recommendations.
   

  

 Establish release gates for both integration changes and AI prompt/tool updates to prevent silent degradation.
   

  

* Monitoring, Troubleshooting \& Observability


 Set up monitoring dashboards and alerts for flows, APIs, and event\-driven pipelines establish traceability with correlation IDs and end\-to\-end tracking.
   

  

 Diagnose and resolve integration issues using structured logs, message traces, and failure\-mode analysis.
   

  

 Create AI\-native operational experiences such as conversational root\-cause analysis, runbook\-guided remediation, and impact analysis—bounded by role\-based access and approval workflows.
   

  

* Integration Strategy \& Maturity Enablement


 Apply integration advisory practices to design hybrid integration platforms and define integration best practices across teams.
   

  

 Use integration assessment approaches to improve integration maturity, standardize patterns, and automate repeatable architectural governance where feasible.
   

  

**Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)**
 Strong hands\-on expertise with SAP BTP Integration Suite concepts and building blocks (cloud integration/iFlows, transformation patterns, monitoring).
   

  

 Proven ability to implement message mappings, routing patterns, and transformation logic across enterprise data formats.
   

  

 Practical scripting capability (e.g., Groovy) for advanced integration flow customization and performance tuning.
   

  

 Solid API design and management fundamentals (security, throttling, lifecycle/versioning, observability).
   

  

 AI\-native delivery capability: tool\-augmented workflows, retrieval\-grounded outputs, measurable evaluation loops, and safe action boundaries.
   

  

 Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
   

  

 Event\-driven integration design and enterprise messaging patterns.
   

  

 Connector\-based integrations with third\-party SaaS ecosystems.
   

  

 Migration and modernization experience from legacy integration platforms to cloud integration.
   

  

 Integration governance and advisory methodologies for enterprise\-wide standardization.
   

  

 What This Role Does Not Center On
   

  

 Training or fine\-tuning foundation models from scratch.
   

  

 AI\-assisted only integration work this role builds and owns AI behavior in the integration layer (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability).
   

  

 Value Delivered
   

  

 Faster integration delivery via intelligent flow generation, mapping recommendations, and script optimization.
   

  

 Higher reliability and lower run cost via anomaly detection, predictive operations, and grounded troubleshooting.
   

  

 Scalable integration landscapes through standardized patterns, governance, and maturity enablement.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 A 15 years full time education is required

title: Technical Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced
 **AI Architect with 10\+ years** 
 of technology experience to architect an
 **Agentic AI led Project Setup Automation** 
 program for a global Life Sciences / CRO client. This is a
 **dual\-track architect role** 
 : the candidate owns the traditional Azure application architecture — a React and Node workspace with its workflow, rules and action management services — and the AI architecture on top: deterministic defaulting, retrieval\-grounded suggestion with citations, and a tool\-using agent writing to Oracle Fusion PPM through Oracle Integration Cloud. The ideal candidate will combine
 **deep Azure application and integration architecture with hands\-on LLM, RAG and agentic design, and a working functional understanding of Oracle Fusion and OIC** 
 . Hands\-on and client\-facing, accountable for autonomy tiers, accuracy thresholds, the audit evidence record, and clearing client architecture and AI governance reviews under GxP and SOX.
 



**Role and responsibilities** 



* Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture — Azure application services, the integration layer and the AI services — bound by one versioned canonical request schema, and architect the application stack: React and TypeScript SPA, Node / NestJS BFF with an OpenAPI contract, PostgreSQL, Redis, containerised on Azure App Service or AKS.
* Design the workflow and action management services — versioned state machine, gap\-typed routing, SLA and tiered approvals, typed idempotent commands, and an immutable evidence record.
* Architect the AI services layer — deterministic defaulting via frequency tables with tie\-break rules and reason codes, hybrid retrieval (dense plus BM25\) with re\-ranking and citations, and the evaluation rails: golden set, accuracy thresholds, model registry and drift monitoring.
* Architect the agent runtime and planner with a tool registry over Oracle Integration Cloud REST endpoints: plan, confirm, execute, verify, write evidence.
* Define tiered autonomy and approval classes per tool — read auto\-executes, low\-risk on user confirmation, high\-risk on named approval — with confidence banding and human\-in\-the\-loop escalation.
* Apply functional understanding of Oracle Fusion PPM (project creation, templates, key members, DFFs, project\-contract link) to field mapping, template selection rules and API coverage assessment.
* Work with the OIC team on orchestration flow contracts, mapping, fault handling, dead\-letter queues and idempotent retries keyed on a workspace\-issued correlation key.
* Own security, identity and observability — Entra ID SSO, OAuth 2\.0 on\-behalf\-of with Fusion duty\-role inheritance, secrets in Key Vault, OpenTelemetry tracing, and CI/CD with automated regression.
* Lead client architecture, security and AI governance reviews (ARB, AI Council, EIG), mentor the delivery POD, and stay hands\-on through prototypes, the phase gate and handover.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* 10\+ years in application and solution architecture, including 3\+ years architecting AI or GenAI solutions.
* Proven delivery of both traditional enterprise applications and AI applications on Azure.
* Pharmaceutical, CRO, Healthcare or Life Sciences experience in GxP and SOX regulated settings.
* An agentic or RAG solution taken from proof of concept to production against measured accuracy.
* Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure AI Engineer certification preferred.

title: AI Agent Engineer
description:
**About Manifest Global**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility \- connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans
 **Cialfo** 
 (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools),
 **BridgeU** 
 (university guidance for international schools globally),
 **Kaaiser** 
 (trusted study abroad counseling across India and Southeast Asia), and
 **Explore** 
 (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 What This Role Is
   

 AI agents — systems that reason, plan, take action across tools, and complete real work end\-to\-end — have moved from research demos to production infrastructure in the last eighteen months. The companies that build them well will define the next decade of what software is and what people do.
   

 Manifest Global sits at one of the most operationally complex intersections in the world. Every day, our platforms move students between continents, counselors between conversations, applications between deadlines, universities between recruiting cycles, and agents between thousands of families making generational decisions. The work is high\-stakes, high\-volume, and full of judgment calls — exactly the kind of work that breaks under brittle automation and exactly the kind of work AI agents, built properly, can transform.
   

 That is the bet behind this role. Not chatbots. Not wrappers. Agents that actually do the work — drafting university shortlists with reasoning a counselor would defend, surfacing the right student profile to the right admissions officer, catching the document that's about to make an application fail before a human sees it. Agents that hold context across long workflows. Agents that know when to escalate and when to keep going. Agents that get measurably better as more of the network uses them.
   

 You will build those agents across the Manifest portfolio, in production, at a scale that matters.
   

 What Makes This Role Different
   

 Most companies hiring AI agent builders right now have one of two problems. They have the data but no real product surface to deploy into, so the agents sit in demos waiting for distribution. Or they have the distribution but the underlying data is too fragmented to support agents that work in production. Manifest has both. Cialfo's 2,000\+ schools, BridgeU's international school footprint, Kaaiser's three decades of placement data, Explore's 1,000\+ universities — that is the substrate. Saige, already live inside Cialfo, is proof that AI in this domain works when it is built well. Your job is to extend that surface across the portfolio.
   

 This is not a research role. The agents you build will be used by real counselors, students, admissions officers, and partners within weeks of being shipped, not quarters. The feedback loop is tight. The accountability is direct. If an agent you built makes a bad shortlist, a counselor will tell you the same week. That is the speed at which good AI products get built right now, and it is the speed this role operates at.
   

 The broader EdTech market is contracting. Manifest is growing. AI is the lever — and the people who build the agents will define what the next version of this company looks like.
   

 What You Own
   

**The agent platform**
* Design and build production AI agents across Manifest's brands, starting with the highest\-leverage workflows in counseling, admissions outreach, and operational triage
* Own the architecture decisions: model selection, tool use, memory, evaluation, guardrails, and the orchestration layer that holds it together
* Build the abstractions that turn one good agent into a platform


**Evaluation and reliability**
* Define what "working" means for each agent in measurable terms, and build the evaluation infrastructure that proves it
* Own latency, cost, and accuracy as engineering disciplines, not afterthoughts
* Build the safety layer: when an agent should stop, when it should escalate, when it should ask


**Integration into product**
* Work directly with product and engineering teams across Cialfo, BridgeU, Kaaiser, and Explore to ship agents into the surfaces where users already are
* Translate fuzzy user problems into agent specifications that can actually be built
* Close the loop between user feedback and model behaviour faster than anyone in this industry currently does


**Technical direction**
* Set the standard for how AI agents are built at Manifest — tooling, frameworks, model providers, evaluation harness, deployment patterns
* Stay close enough to the research frontier to know what is becoming possible six months out, and ship accordingly


 What Success Looks Like
   

* The markers below reflect where Manifest's AI agent function is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
* In the first weeks, you have a clear point of view on which workflows across the portfolio are the highest\-leverage places to deploy agents — and you can defend that view to the counselors, product leaders, and engineers who will use what you build. You have started building, not just planning. Something is in the hands of a real user by the end of month three.
* By mid\-period, at least one agent you have built is in production, used daily, and measurably better than the manual workflow it replaced. The evaluation infrastructure exists and is trusted by the people whose work depends on it. Other engineers across the group know how to build agents the Manifest way because you have made that pattern legible.
* Longer term, the agent layer is infrastructure, not a project. New product surfaces ship with AI agents as a default, not an exception. The work you built outlasts the specific models you started with, because the architecture you chose absorbed model upgrades without rewriting from scratch. The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.


 What You Bring
   

* You have spent the better part of your career building software that runs in production — and somewhere in the last two years, you became one of the people other engineers go to when they have a hard question about LLMs, agents, or how to actually make this stuff work outside a notebook. You have shipped something agentic. Not a prototype. Something users use.
* You know the current frontier well enough to be opinionated about it. You have working views on which model providers to use for what, which orchestration patterns hold up under real load, where the abstractions in popular agent frameworks leak, and how to evaluate something that doesn't have a single correct answer. You write production\-quality Python. You are comfortable with the surrounding stack: vector stores, prompt management, evaluation frameworks, observability tooling.
* You think in systems, not in prompts. When you see a workflow, you instinctively map where reasoning happens, where state lives, where tools get called, where humans need to stay in the loop. You build for the model that ships in six months, not the one that exists today.
* You are self\-directed in the way this kind of role requires. There is no finished playbook for what you are building. The questions you will face — which agent to build next, how much to invest in evaluation infrastructure, when to use a smaller model and when to use a frontier one — will not have obvious answers. You make calls, you ship, you learn, you adjust.
* Somewhere underneath the technical depth, you care about what the agents you build actually do in the world. The fact that a student in Delhi or Manila or Lagos is going to make a better university decision because of code you wrote — that matters to you.
* Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building in AI and your first reaction was the agents I want to build are exactly the ones this company needs built. That's the person this role is for.


 Why Manifest
   

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 For this role specifically, the AI agents you build are not adjacent to the mission — they are the mission's primary lever. Counselors cannot serve every student who needs guidance. Universities cannot manually reach every qualified applicant. Operations teams cannot manually track every application across every destination. The only way the infrastructure we are building reaches the scale the problem actually demands is through AI agents that hold their own in real work. That is what this seat is for.
   

*Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50\+ countries.*

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
 Hunch is a dating app built for follow\-through \- designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back\-and\-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
   

  

 With 2\.4M\+ daters, 1\.47M\+ dates planned, and 100% photo\-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe\-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post\-AI world.
   

  

 Link to our fundraising announcement
   

  

**Key Offerings Of Hunch**
* One Drop a Day: A small, hand\-picked set of photo\-verified profiles arrives daily \- chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place \- no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing \- just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time \- nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.


**About The Role**
 We're on the lookout for a SDE\-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose — and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own backend features end\-to\-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async \& event\-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM\-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.


**What You'll Bring**
* 5\+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual\-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node \+ Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice\-to\-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design \& delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands\-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End\-to\-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product\-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.


**Preferred Experience**
* ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.
* LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self\-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.
* Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.
* Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive pay along with an annual performance\-linked incentive (PLI).
* Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.
* Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).


**Life at Hunch**
 Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall \- getting two interested people into the same room.
   

  

**What We Hire For \- The ABCs**
 Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:
   

  

* Authenticity \- Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.
* Boldness \- Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity \- The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.


**How We Work**
* Ownership, not theater \- You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real \- We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week \- show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out \- Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems \- You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.


**Backed by Global Investors**
 Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
   

  

**Experienced Leadership**
 Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) \- serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer\-tech startup.

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

 The ideal candidate will serve as the technical lead for BCG's SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud ERP platform, driving architectural decisions and delivering solutions for complex business requirements across the firm's Finance function. Working within an Agile squad environment, this role goes beyond hands\-on delivery — the candidate will be responsible for defining the technical direction, establishing best practices, and ensuring the overall quality and scalability of the ABAP Cloud extensibility landscape. You will also serve as a coach and mentor to junior and mid\-level ABAP engineers, elevating the capability of the broader team
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 10\+ years of ABAP development experience, with at least 2–3 years in S/4HANA Cloud (Public or Private Edition).

**Deep Expertise In**
* 
+ CDS View modeling and virtual data model (VDM) design
+ RAP BO lifecycle including managed and unmanaged scenarios
+ WRICEF object development at scale
+ Key User and Developer Extensibility frameworks
+ SAP API and Communication Scenario configuration
+ BADI Framework implementation with upgrade\-safe techniques
+ Adobe Forms in S/4HANA Cloud
+ Object\-Oriented ABAP and Design Patterns
+ Job creation and monitoring in cloud environments

* Strong grasp of SAP Clean Core strategy and its practical implications for extensibility decisions.
* Proven ability to set technical direction, govern standards, and influence without formal authority.
* Experience coaching and mentoring engineers across different levels of seniority.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical teams and non\-technical business stakeholders.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 A dynamic group of cross\-functional global agile team\-members representing Finance, IT, and Change Management at all levels of their career. You will also support BCG users across the organization as well as BCG suppliers and business partners.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**
**Architecture \& Solution Design**
* Architecting end\-to\-end extensibility solutions for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, balancing business complexity with SAP's Clean Core principles.
* Leading solution design for complex WRICEF objects, RAP Business Objects, and API\-based integrations, ensuring scalability, reusability, and upgrade compliance.
* Evaluating trade\-offs between Key User Extensibility, Developer Extensibility, and side\-by\-side extension approaches, and recommending the right fit for each scenario.
* Defining and governing the overall technical blueprint for ABAP Cloud extensions across the ERP landscape.


**Technical Leadership \& Standards**
* Establishing and enforcing ABAP development best practices, coding standards, and design patterns across the team.

* Driving performance tuning and optimization strategies at an architectural level, not just at the object level.

**Delivery \& Hands\-on Contribution**
* Designing and implementing advanced CDS Views, RAP BOs, BADIs, OData/REST APIs, and Communication Arrangements for complex business scenarios.
* Overseeing Transport Request strategy including Software Collections, TR sequencing, and dependency management across landscapes.
* Performing deep\-dive issue analysis, root cause analysis (RCA), and impact assessments for critical production and test environment issues.
* Configuring and managing Job Scheduling and Application Jobs in the S/4HANA Cloud environment.


**Coaching \& Mentoring**
* Acting as a technical mentor and go\-to resource for junior and mid\-level ABAP engineers on the team.
* Conducting knowledge\-sharing sessions, technical workshops, and design walkthroughs to upskill the broader engineering team.
* Supporting engineers in debugging complex issues in Eclipse ADT and guiding them toward sustainable, best\-practice solutions.

title: AI Integration Engineer – Digital Transformation (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
   

  

 Joining the People \& Organization Digital Transformation team, you will work directly with the Head of Digital Transformation and a close\-knit team of four engineers based in Berlin. Your work will span automation engineering, AI application deployment on top of HR systems — with direct impact on how Flix manages its people technology globally. Are you an engineer who knows how to turn AI ideas into real\-world applications—deploying Claude\-based solutions, building integrations, and putting the right security and governance in place? If you’ve built innovative AI products, like those emerging from HR AI Day and beyond, and have the engineering mindset to take them from idea to scalable solution, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 This is a pure technical role. There is no administrative overhead, no time\-critical firefighting and no expectation of HR domain expertise on day one — we can teach you the domain. This is an exciting, problem\-solving\-focused role at the intersection of AI, automation, and HR solution architecture. While the technical skills can be developed, what we cannot teach is the engineering mindset, depth of integration expertise, and natural instinct for automation that this role demands.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role based in Gurugram OR Bangalore with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week. The role has a Europe and APAC\-facing scope, with regular collaboration across Central European time zones.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Lead the technical workstream supporting internal automation projects —evaluating global HR system options, assessing integration complexity, mapping data dependencies and supporting potential migration execution from Workday or equivalent enterprise HR platforms.
* Design and build automation and integration workflows using n8n,UiPath and Python — including multi\-step orchestration, exception handling, retries, monitoring, alerting and structured documentation.
* Build and maintain enterprise system integrations using REST APIs,OAuth 2\.0, webhooks, SFTP and event\-driven patterns across the HR technology landscape.
* Develop secure AI integrations connecting platforms such as Claude with HRIS and enterprise systems using MCP servers, connectors, plugins and agent frameworks — with appropriate access controls and user\-level permissions.
* Deploy and operate internal applications and AI\-powered tools on Flix's hosting infrastructure (AWS), including RBAC/ABAC access models, secrets management, credential rotation and audit logging.
* Analyse business processes end\-to\-end, identify automation opportunities and design scalable target\-state architectures that can support both the evaluation phase and eventual migration or implementation execution.
* Engage with cross\-functional stakeholders across Europe and APAC —translating complex technical requirements into clear solution designs and project deliverables across 3–6 month project scopes.


**About You**
* 6–7\+ years of hands\-on professional experience in automation engineering, systems integration, solution architecture or AI application development. Exceptional mid\-level candidates with strong technical depth will also be considered.
* Demonstrable experience building and delivering automation workflows and enterprise integrations — this is an engineering role, not a data analytics or reporting role. Experience in Python, n8n and UiPath is essential.
* Strong working knowledge of API design and integration patterns —REST APIs, OAuth 2\.0, webhooks, SFTP and event\-driven architectures.
* Hands\-on experience deploying and operating applications on AWS,including Lambda, API Gateway, Bedrock, Glue, Secrets Manager and CI/CD pipeline management.
* Solid software engineering fundamentals — Git/GitHub, Docker,structured release management and familiarity with security practices including least privilege, RBAC/ABAC and credential handling.
* Experience with Workday or enterprise HRIS platforms (configuration, integration or migration) is a strong advantage and a meaningful differentiator — though not an absolute requirement if your automation and integration fundamentals are strong.
* Comfort working across European and APAC time zones, collaborating with a Berlin\-based team and contributing to strategic cross\-functional initiatives.
* n8n Level 1 or Level 2 certification is strongly preferred.


 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning \& Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


 To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations \- Flix Career
   

  

**Why Join Flix?**
 At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
   

  

 As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
   

  

 If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As an Engineering Manager on BCG's CT GenAI Portfolio, you will serve as the technical and operational lead for enterprise GenAI platform delivery — owning integration architecture, release governance, vendor management, and security oversight — while working with the team of engineers, product analysts, and partnering with global stakeholders to translate BCG's AI strategy into scalable, enterprise\-ready solutions.
   

  

**Release Management:** 
 Own end\-to\-end release governance for the enterprise GenAI platform, risk assessments, deployment readiness, and coordination of release cycles across engineering, security, legal, and business teams.
   

  

**Integration Architecture \& Oversight:** 
 Define and govern the integration framework for the GenAI platform, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) architecture, platform interoperability standards, and onboarding design principles — ensuring scalable, secure, and consistent enterprise adoption across BCG.
   

  

**Stakeholder Collaboration:** 
 Partner with Product, Security, Legal, and business leaders across CT GenAI and the broader firm to translate BCG's AI strategy into platform\-wide, scalable solutions aligned with enterprise standards.
   

  

**Vendor \& Security Management:** 
 Lead architecture and security reviews, manage third\-party vendor relationships, and ensure all integrations meet BCG's enterprise compliance, audit, and quality standards.
   

  

**GenAI Capability Enablement:** 
 Stay current on GenAI platform developments, new model releases, and emerging integration patterns — acting as an evangelist for capabilities that should be prioritized for BCG's AI roadmap.
   

  

**Documentation \& Governance:** 
 Create clear specification documents for platform modifications, integration designs, and new capability additions, maintaining robust audit trails and governance processes.
   

  

**Team Leadership \& Support Operations:** 
 Support and manage L2 and L3 GenAI engineering teams, providing technical guidance, overseeing incident escalation and resolution, ensuring SLA adherence, and driving continuous improvement in platform operations and support quality.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field, with 7\+ years of experience in enterprise platform engineering, technical program management, or integration architecture.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, APIs, and platform architecture — including familiarity with AI/GenAI platforms and MCP (Model Context Protocol).
* Proven track record of managing complex, multi\-stakeholder release programs in large, global enterprise environments.
* Experience leading security and architecture reviews and managing vendor relationships in an enterprise technology context.
* Prior experience in a consulting, platform, or SaaS environment with exposure to enterprise\-scale AI or productivity tool implementations is strongly preferred.
* Experience developing and executing comprehensive test plans and release validation frameworks is preferred.
* Skilled in stakeholder management, with the ability to operate effectively across technical and business audiences at a global scale.
* Familiarity with GenAI trends, agentic frameworks, and enterprise AI adoption patterns is preferred.
* Experience working in agile teams and applying agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe), including sprint planning, backlog management, and cross\-functional agile ceremonies; familiarity with agile delivery practices in an enterprise platform or engineering context is preferred.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

* Engineers within the CT GenAI Portfolio, including integration and platform squads.
* Product, Security, Legal, and Procurement stakeholders across CT GenAI and the broader BCG


 firm.
   

  

* Third\-party GenAI vendors and platform partners.
* QA and release validation teams for platform enhancements and new capability rollouts.


 Additional info
   

  

 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Anaplan Model Builder
description:

 You will collaborate closely with Cloud Infrastructure peers, SREs, Security Engineering, and product teams across geographies.

**Cloud Infrastructure Engineering (AWS)**

**AI Agents, Orchestration \& Multi‑Agent Systems**

* Proven track record designing and operating production\-grade, multi‑account/multi‑region AWS environments with a focus on security, reliability, and cost.
* Experience implementing observability for infrastructure services (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards).
* Demonstrated ability to own complex projects end\-to\-end: requirements, design, implementation, rollout, and post‑launch improvements.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills; comfortable working with distributed teams and multiple stakeholders (SRE, Security, product engineering, leadership).


**AI / Agentic Skills – Required**

+ AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph\-style, CrewAI\-like, or custom agent patterns), or
+ Orchestrating multi\-step AI workflows using tools, function calling, or custom planners.

* Ability to translate infra problems into agentic workflows (e.g., “given alerts \+ context, generate and execute an actionable runbook; escalate with a summarized context if confidence is low”).

**Nice to Have**

**Success in This Role**
**In Your First 12–18 Months, Success Looks Like**
* You are a go‑to engineer for complex AWS infrastructure questions in your domain.
* You have delivered at least one or two production AI‑agent workflows that measurably improve Cloud Infra operations (e.g., reduced MTTR, reduced manual toil, or better cost visibility).

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job About Camley Camley is building the agentic infrastructure for private markets. Our clients are leading private equity and infrastructure investment firms, and we are at the forefront of transforming a $55T asset class that still runs on spreadsheets and software built in the 1990s. What Harvey did for legal, we are doing for private markets. We are building the multi\-agent architecture that operates funds end\-to\-end, solving the highest\-stakes problems investment firms face with accuracy and speed. Our agents are not just chatbots \- they move money and execute workflows autonomously. We are backed by top VCs, incl. the first investor in Lovable and one of the most technical AI investors in Silicon Valley responsible for building Uber’s core algorithm. Camley is built by a team from Stanford, Harvard, IIT Delhi, and Penn, with decades of industry experience at McKinsey, SquarePoint, and Deutsche Bank \+ building foundation models for an Accel\-backed startup. About the role We are hiring a founding full\-stack AI engineer. You will build products end\-to\-end and shape agent architecture and technical decisions alongside the CTO. You’ll build the core intelligence layer \- language models for reading documents, a knowledge graph \& vector DB for storing data and relationships, a calculation engine for the fund mathematics and an orchestration layer that coordinates these into workflows that an auditor can sign. You'll own high\-impact features across the stack, from model integration to infrastructure. We are a small team working across London and New York. We are open to remote/hybrid for the right candidate. We are a lean team with a high bar for excellence, and hours will at times be intense as in any high\-growth startup. In return, you get the autonomy to do some of the best work of your life, and a founding team that values openness, empathy, and not taking ourselves too seriously. What you will do Design and integrate LLM\-powered pipelines and build agents that execute multi\-step workflows reliably Build the agent harness: orchestration, tool use, retries, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and optimise agent performance across prompts, models, tools, and context Own the evals, validation, audit trails, and observability that keep agent behaviour correct, explainable, and improving Ship features across our React frontend and Python backend, from database schemas and APIs to polished UI, from idea to production Work directly with the founders and early customers to understand real fund workflows, and turn operational pain into shipped product What we are looking for We are looking for an exceptional engineer who wants the autonomy to shape a product from day 0, who loves the challenge of maintaining a strong quality bar while shipping extremely quickly, and who knows how to make smart tradeoffs to get features in front of customers. Strong candidates have: Built products from 0 to 1 5\+ years of experience building production software Strong full\-stack fundamentals across frontend, backend, and infra Proficiency in Python and production experience building LLM systems/agent frameworks High ownership: you do not wait for a spec to start solving a problem Made AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) a core part of how they work Passion for building effective domain\-specific agents Bonus points if you have: Experience in finance or financial services Data\-intensive backend work Early\-stage startup experience Technology stack Typescript/React, Python (FastAPI), Postgres, AWS, and an agent orchestration layer you will help design. Please do not submit AI generated applications.

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a results\-oriented Senior Performance Advertising Engineer to own and drive the optimization of our buyer\-side and performance marketing systems. In this role, you will be directly responsible for designing algorithms, building data systems, and refining optimization loops that drive Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) for our Advertisers and Agencies.You will own the technical architecture and end\-to\-end evaluation, implementation, and scaling of robust data pipelines for attribution data. This position spans our complete omnichannel environment, requiring expert\-level performance engine development across Mobile App (including privacy\-aware frameworks like SKAdNetwork and Privacy Sandbox), Video, Connected TV (CTV),and Desktop environments.
   

  

**What You'll Do**

* Desktop: Innovate alternative identity framework integrations (e.g., UID2, LiveRamp ATS) to sustain high attribution fidelity post\-third\-party cookies.
* Data Pipeline Evaluation: Constantly audit existing data ingestion points for architectural flaws, data loss, or systemic latencies that negatively skew attribution accuracy and campaign performance.
* Scalable Systems Engineering: Write high\-performance, low\-latency, and memory\-efficient code (Python, Go, Java, or C\+\+) matching our ultra\-scaled backend layer that processes trillions of monthly events.


**We'd Love For You To Have**

description:
**About This Job**
**MyOperator**
**Location:** 
 Greater Delhi Area, India

 On\-site

 Software Development,Telecommunications,IT Services and IT Consulting
   

  

**Job Description**
 About MyOperator
   

  

 MyOperator is a Business AI Operator and category leader that unifies WhatsApp, Calls, and AI\-powered chatbots \& voice bots into one intelligent business communication platform.Unlike fragmented communication tools, MyOperator combines automation, intelligence, and workflow integration to help businesses run WhatsApp campaigns, manage calls, deploy AI chatbots, and track performance — all from a single no\-code platform.Trusted by 12,000\+ brands including Amazon, Domino’s, Apollo, and Razor\-pay, MyOperator enables faster responses, higher resolution rates, and scalable customer engagement
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 We’re hiring a Front Deployed Engineer (FDE)—a customer\-facing, field\-deployed engineer who owns the end\-to\-end delivery of AI bots/agents.
   

  

 This role is “frontline”: you’ll work directly with customers (often onsite), translate business reality into bot workflows, do prompt engineering \+ knowledge grounding, ship deployments, and iterate until it works reliably in production.
   

  

 Think: solutions engineer \+ implementation engineer \+ prompt engineer, with a strong bias for execution.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Requirement Discovery \& Stakeholder Interaction


 Join customer calls alongside Sales and Revenue teams.Ask targeted questions to understand business objectives, user journeys, automation expectations, and edge cases.Identify data sources (CRM, APIs, Excel, SharePoint, etc.) required for the solution.Act as the AI subject\-matter expert during client discussions.
   

  

* Use Case \& Solution Documentation


 Convert discussions into clear, structured use case documents, including:Problem statement \& goals.Current vs. proposed conversational flows.Chatbot conversation logic, integrations, and dependencies.Assumptions, limitations, and success criteria.
   

  

* Customer Delivery Ownership


 Own deployment of AI bots for customer use\-cases (lead qualification, support, booking, etc.). Run workshops to capture processes, FAQs, edge cases, and success metrics. Drive the go\-live process: requirements through monitoring and improvement.
   

  

* Prompt Engineering \& Conversation Design


 Craft prompts, tool instructions, guardrails, fallbacks, and escalation policies for stable behavior. Build structured conversational flows: intents, entities, routing, handoff, and compliant responses. Create reusable prompt patterns and "prompt packs."
   

  

* Testing, Debugging \& Iteration


 Analyze logs to find failure modes (misclassification, hallucination, poor handling). Create test sets ("golden conversations"), run regressions, and measure improvements. Coordinate with Product/Engineering for platform needs.
   

  

* Integrations \& Technical Coordination


 Integrate bots with APIs/webhooks (CRM, ticketing, internal tools) to complete workflows. Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate fixes/root\-cause analysis.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Customer bots go live quickly and show high containment \+ high task completion with low escalation.You can diagnose failures from transcripts/logs and fix them with prompt/workflow/knowledge changes.Customers trust you as the “AI delivery owner”—clear communication, realistic timelines, crisp execution.
   

  

 Requirements (Must Have)
   

  

 2–5 years in customer\-facing delivery roles: implementation, solutions engineering, customer success engineering, or similar.Hands\-on comfort with LLMs and prompt engineering (structured outputs, guardrails, tool use, iteration).Strong communication: workshops, requirement capture, crisp documentation, stakeholder management.Technical fluency: APIs/webhooks concepts, JSON, debugging logs, basic integration troubleshooting.Willingness to be front deployed (customer calls/visits as needed).
   

  

 Good to Have (Nice to Have)
   

  

 Experience with chatbots/voicebots, IVR, WhatsApp automation, conversational AI platforms with at least a couple of projects.Understanding of metrics like containment, resolution rate, response latency, CSAT drivers.Prior SaaS onboarding/delivery experience in mid\-market or enterprises.
   

  

 Working Style \& Traits We Value
   

  

 High agency: you don’t wait for perfect specs—you create clarity and ship.Customer empathy \+ engineering discipline.Strong bias for iteration: deploy → learn → improve.Calm under ambiguity (real customer environments are chaotic by default).
