description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech
description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
   

  

 UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises \- Same\-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1\-hr/3\-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time\-critical orders on\-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot\-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub\-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non\-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill\-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed\-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large\-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Senior Platform Engineer** 




**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Candidates should be based out of Delhi NCR / Bhopal)
 



**Experience:** 
 6\-10 years total · 3\+ years owning platform architecture or data infrastructure in production
 



**About Sutra.AI** 




 Sutra.AI is a complete 'Data to Value' AI business transformation platform designed specifically for Business Builders. Unlike other platforms that cater to AI Builders or large enterprises with substantial budgets, Sutra.AI is purpose\-built for mid\-market businesses without the need of AI expertise. Developed over 4 years, Sutra.AI is a patent\-pending, fully orchestrated AI SaaS platform. It identifies and executes AI use cases to enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, revenue growth, profitability, innovation, and risk reduction.
 



 We are in scale\-up mode \- shipping fast, onboarding customers continuously, and standardizing the platform engineering patterns that compound across every customer and product line.
 



**About the Role** 




 This is a hands\-on engineering role with architectural ownership. You will spend the majority of your time designing and writing code, not running a program office and not managing a team. You will take ambiguous requirements from customer environments \- undocumented schemas, legacy ERP systems, inconsistent data quality and turn them into reliable, repeatable platform capability.
 



 You will operate with a high degree of independence, make pragmatic build\-versus\-buy calls, and be accountable for how the platform performs, scales, and stays up in front of customers.
 



**What You'll Do** 




**1\. Platform Architecture \& System Design** 



* Own the architecture of Sutra.AI’s core platform services \- service boundaries, API contracts, data models, and integration patterns across the stack.
* Translate solution and customer requirements into concrete engineering approaches, reference architectures, and build sequences the wider team can execute against.
* Design for multi\-tenancy, scale, and reuse so that platform capability built for one customer generalizes to the next.
* Proactively challenge architectural gaps, evaluate technical feasibility, and make pragmatic build\-versus\-configure decisions with clear trade\-off reasoning.
* Drive technical decisions through design documents, architecture reviews, and working prototypes rather than opinion.



**2\. Data Infrastructure \& Pipelines** 



* Design, build, and operate ingestion pipelines from diverse customer systems \- ERP, CRM, MES, relational and non\-relational databases, files, and APIs.
* Own batch and streaming data processing, orchestration, transformation layers, and the storage architecture underneath analytics and AI workloads.
* Build data quality, schema\-drift detection, lineage, and reconciliation controls so downstream models and dashboards can be trusted.
* Model relationships between operational systems, workflows, and data sources where documentation does not exist, and formalize what you discover.
* Optimize query performance, storage cost, and pipeline throughput as data volumes and customer count grow.
* Build and maintain the data foundations that AI workloads depend on, including retrieval, embedding, and feature pipelines.



**3\. Security, Governance \& Multi\-Tenancy** 



* Implement tenant isolation, access control, secrets management, and encryption standards across platform and data layers.
* Build the governance controls \- audit trails, retention, PII handling \- required to operate credibly in enterprise and regulated customer environments.
* Partner with engineering leadership to align platform practices to compliance frameworks relevant to our customers.



**4\. Engineering Standards \& Technical Leadership** 



* Establish platform engineering standards, reusable components, internal libraries, and documentation that raise the whole team’s throughput.
* Mentor engineers through design discussions, code review, and pair programming; lead by example on code quality.
* Identify engineering and operational risks early, design mitigation plans, and resolve them with stakeholders rather than only reporting them.
* Collaborate with Implementation, Solutioning, and Product teams so platform decisions stay tied to customer value and delivery timelines.



**Requirements** 




**Must\-Have** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 6\-10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years owning platform, infrastructure, or data engineering systems in production.
* Demonstrated architecture ownership \- you have designed systems end to end, not only implemented someone else’s design.
* Strong backend engineering skills in Python (and comfort with Node.js/TypeScript services), including APIs, async systems, and distributed architectures.
* Deep data engineering experience: ETL/ELT design, batch and stream processing, orchestration, and warehouse or lakehouse modelling.
* Strong SQL and database engineering \- schema design, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning across relational and NoSQL stores.
* Hands\-on cloud experience (AWS primary; Azure or GCP acceptable) including compute, storage, managed databases, networking, and IAM.
* Working experience with containerization, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Proven end\-to\-end ownership: systems you shipped independently from problem statement to production and then operated.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills across layers \- data quality, application behaviour, infrastructure, and system design.
* Ability to work through ambiguity: undocumented systems, incomplete requirements, and competing priorities across concurrent engagements.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders.



**Preferred** 



* Experience in startups or fast\-growth product environments with high ownership and low process overhead.
* Experience building platform or data foundations for AI/ML workloads \- retrieval systems, vector stores, feature or embedding pipelines.
* Multi\-tenant B2B SaaS platform experience.
* Exposure to enterprise system integration (ERP, CRM) and to industrial domains such as manufacturing, supply chain, or production.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2\) and enterprise security review processes.
* Open\-source contributions, published technical writing, or internal platform tooling you built and others adopted.



**Core Technical Competencies** 




**Languages:** 
 Python (primary), SQL, TypeScript/JavaScript; Bash for automation
 



**Data Engineering:** 
 Airflow or equivalent orchestration, dbt, Spark, Kafka or similar streaming, batch and incremental pipeline design
 



**Storage \& Query:** 
 PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, object storage, columnar warehouses, Trino or equivalent query engines
 



**Cloud \& Infrastructure:** 
 AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC) primary; Azure/GCP secondary; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
 



**DevOps \& Reliability:** 
 CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, monitoring and alerting, logging and tracing, incident response
 



**APIs \& Services:** 
 REST and GraphQL design, FastAPI, Node.js/Express, event\-driven and microservices patterns, authentication and authorization (OAuth, JWT)
 



**AI Platform Exposure:** 
 Vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, FAISS), RAG and retrieval infrastructure, LLM orchestration frameworks
 



**Security \& Governance:** 
 Tenant isolation, secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, access control, audit logging
 



**Success Metrics** 



* Platform Reliability: uptime, performance, and stability of platform services and pipelines in customer environments.
* Data Trust: pipeline success rates, data quality issues caught before delivery, and reduction in analytics and AI defects traced to data.
* Delivery Leverage: reduction in time and effort to onboard a new customer or stand up a new use case on existing platform capability.
* Engineering Quality: first\-time build quality, defect rates, and reduction in quality\-driven escalations across engagements.
* Efficiency: cloud and infrastructure cost per customer as scale increases.



**The Ideal Candidate** 



* Builder\-owner: you take a problem from an ambiguous statement to running a production system without needing constant direction.
* Systems thinker: you see how components interact, and you design for the failure modes as much as the happy path.
* Pragmatic: you optimize for what the business needs now while keeping the door open for what it will need next, and you can tell those apart.
* Detective mindset with data: undocumented schemas and messy source systems are a puzzle to solve, not a blocker to escalate.

title: Application Engineer, Aladdin Product Engineering, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
 At BlackRock, technology is the foundation of our business. As a VP, Application Engineer, you’ll lead by example — architecting, coding, and mentoring teams to build resilient systems that power our global Aladdin Accounting Retail fund operations. You’ll design and deliver enterprise\-scale software with a focus on reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a technical leader who enjoys staying close to the code, guiding design decisions, and solving complex data challenges — all while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. You’ll also help the team explore and adopt emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted engineering and Generative AI, where they can meaningfully improve engineering productivity, operational workflows, or user experience.
   

  

**About Aladdin Accounting**
* Aladdin Accounting is one of the fastest\-growing commercial product businesses within Aladdin.
* A major strategic area within Aladdin and one of BlackRock’s largest engineering investments.
* Responsible for the systems that ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations.

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and develop robust, high\-performance back\-end systems using Java 21\+ and the Spring Boot ecosystem.
* Lead design discussions, code reviews, and architecture sessions with a hands\-on approach.
* Build and maintain microservices and event\-driven systems to process and distribute large\-scale financial data with API\-first approach.
* Develop data integration and pipeline components that connect systems across Snowflake, SQL Server, and real\-time streaming platforms.
* Implement and optimize Redis\-based caching and data stores for low\-latency access patterns.
* Champion best practices for code quality, testing, automation, and performance tuning.
* Mentor engineers to elevate technical craftsmanship, problem\-solving, and design thinking.
* Evaluate and apply emerging AI and GenAI capabilities where appropriate to improve software development, operational efficiency, and user experiences, while maintaining strong standards around security, validation, and maintainability.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to ensure technical solutions align with product goals and business outcomes.


**Qualifications / Competencies**
* B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 8\+ years of professional experience in Java and object\-oriented design.
* Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Deep expertise in SQL Server, including stored procedures, performance tuning, and data modelling.
* Experience with Redis for caching or data persistence.
* Hands\-on exposure to Kafka or similar publish\-subscribe systems for real\-time event processing.
* Familiarity with Snowflake and data pipeline concepts (ETL, batch vs. streaming).
* Exposure to Generative AI and LLM concepts, including prompt engineering, AI\-assisted development, or agentic AI patterns.

 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud\-native environments (AWS/GCP).
* Exposure to observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry).
* Scripting experience in Python for automation or data analysis.
* Interest in applying AI capabilities responsibly within enterprise software and engineering workflows.
* Interest in financial systems, accounting, or investment technology.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Software Development Engineer II, UTR Tech
description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
   

  

 UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises \- Same\-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1\-hr/3\-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time\-critical orders on\-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot\-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub\-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non\-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill\-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed\-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, implement, and deploy software solutions that improve quality, performance, and customer experience across major portions of your team's systems.
* Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross\-functional peers to understand business needs and deliver the right technical solutions, balancing short\-term priorities with long\-term architectural goals.
* Actively participate in code reviews, providing meaningful feedback to teammates at all levels, and mentor engineers on best practices for producing high\-quality, maintainable code.
* Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, driving permanent fixes and continuously improving your team's operational processes and reliability.
* Evaluate and integrate generative artificial intelligence tools where appropriate to augment productivity and code quality, applying responsible practices to refine outputs.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You will start your morning reviewing pull requests and providing constructive feedback to teammates, then shift into designing a new feature that addresses a customer pain point. Afternoons might find you pairing with another engineer to troubleshoot a production issue, documenting your system's architecture for new team members, or evaluating a new approach that could simplify an existing workflow. You will regularly engage with product and engineering partners to align on priorities and share progress.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is focused on building reliable, scalable software that directly serves Amazon's customers. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and an inclusive environment where every voice is heard. As we invest in new capabilities and modernize existing systems, you will play a key role in shaping our technical direction and mentoring the next generation of engineers on the team.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon \- WeWork, Cybercity (in\-person, 6 days)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time · Founding team
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹15 LPA \+ meaningful equity (0\.5–2%)
 



  





**About Switch** 




 Businesses in India lose money every day someone doesn't show up. A restaurant short two waiters on a Friday night, a warehouse missing four loaders before a festive spike, a store with no one to run the counter \- the current fix is a WhatsApp group, an agency that takes a cut and disappears, or the owner working the floor themselves.
 



 Switch is building the layer that fixes this. Shops, restaurants, warehouses, offices, and event venues book Aadhaar\-verified staff \- helpers, guards, cooks, drivers, riders, housekeeping, event crew \- in three taps, often deployed the same day. No advance, replacement guaranteed, clean invoices. On the other side, we give workers real, repeat, dignified income instead of standing at a labour chowk hoping for a day's work.
 



 We're live in Gurgaon, running real shifts for real businesses. We're small, pre\-seed, and moving fast.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'd be our first engineer. Not the first engineer on a team \- the engineering team.
 



 Today a lot of Switch runs on human effort: matching, confirmations, replacements, and support all lean on the ops team and WhatsApp. That's the right way to start and the wrong way to scale. Your job is to turn what ops does by hand into software that does it in seconds, and to build the product surface \- worker app, business app, internal tools \- that lets us go from one city to many.
 



 You will write the code, choose the stack, ship it, and be on the hook when it breaks at 9pm on a Saturday during someone's dinner rush. In return you get real ownership of the technical direction and a front\-row seat to everything else: pricing, ops, hiring, fundraising.
 



  





**What you'll actually build (first 6 months)** 



* Matching engine. Turn a booking into the right worker — availability, location, skill, reliability history, price \- fast enough that "same day" becomes "same hour."
* Worker app. Shift discovery, one\-tap accept, check\-in/check\-out with geofencing, attendance proof, payouts and earnings history.
* Business app \+ web. Booking flow, live shift status, replacements, subscription management, GST\-clean invoicing.
* Ops console. The internal tool that lets one ops person run what currently takes three \- exception queues, no\-show detection and auto\-replacement, escalations.
* Payments and payouts. Collections, worker payouts, reconciliation, refunds \- via UPI and standard PGs.
* Trust infrastructure. Aadhaar/KYC verification flows, background\-check pipeline, ratings, fraud and proxy\-attendance detection.



  





**You're probably a fit if you** 



* Have 2\-6 years shipping production software, and can point at systems you built end\-to\-end \- schema through UI \- that real users depended on.
* Are genuinely full\-stack: comfortable in a backend language and framework of your choice, a modern frontend, a mobile framework (React Native / Flutter / native), SQL, and enough AWS/GCP to run it all without a DevOps hire.
* Have built for scrappy, real\-world conditions: flaky networks, ₹8,000 Android phones, users who won't read instructions, workflows that live in Hindi and WhatsApp.
* Ship fast and ruthlessly scope. You know which corners are safe to cut at pre\-seed and which ones will burn you.
* Will sit with an ops teammate for an afternoon, watch them do a job manually, and go build the thing that deletes it.
* Want to be in the room. This is an in\-person role \- the speed comes from the whiteboard, the desk next to you, and the field visits.



  





**Nice to have, not required** 



* Marketplace, gig\-economy, logistics, or on\-demand experience (Zomato/Swiggy/Urban Company/Rapido/Porter\-shaped problems).
* Payments, UPI, KYC, or fintech integration work.
* Blue\-collar or Bharat\-focused products; vernacular UX.
* You've been early at a startup before and know what year one really feels like.



 The honest part
 



 Pre\-seed means uncertainty. Some of what you build will be thrown away. You'll do things that aren't engineering \- sit in on sales calls, go to a client's warehouse at 7am, help onboard workers. There is no platform team, no on\-call rotation, no one to hand a bug to. Runway is finite and the equity is a bet, not a guarantee.
 



 If that reads as a warning, this isn't your role. If it reads as the interesting part, keep going.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Competitive cash for a pre\-seed startup, plus founding\-level equity.
* Full technical ownership \- stack, architecture, hiring the team under you.
* Direct work with the founders, no layers.
* Health insurance and a laptop of your choosing.
* A product where you can watch the impact the same week you ship it \- in shifts filled, and in what a worker took home.



  





**How to apply** 




 Email hr@switchlocally.com with the subject "Founding Engineer" and include:
 


1. Your GitHub, portfolio, or the most interesting thing you've shipped \- and what your specific contribution was.
2. A short answer: You have one week and no data science team. How would you decide which worker to send to a booking? A paragraph is plenty. We care about how you think, not the right answer.
3. Anything you've built that people outside your company actually used.



 We move fast: intro call, a paid take\-home or a day working with us on a real problem, founder conversation, offer. Typically under two weeks.

title: CRM & Business Systems Architect
description:
Company Description
 
  





 E\-Waste Recyclers India (EWRI) is one of India’s established e\-waste recycling and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) companies, with nearly 18 years of industry experience. As a women\-led, R2v3\-certified organization, EWRI provides secure, compliant, and sustainable technology lifecycle solutions across India.
 



 EWRI serves 5,000\+ clients, including global enterprises, OEMs, institutions, government organizations, and international ITAD and recycling partners requiring execution across India.
 



 With 50,000\+ MT of combined processing capacity, our capabilities span ITAD, secure data sanitization and destruction, data center decommissioning, refurbishment and reuse, asset recovery and remarketing, e\-waste recycling, plastics recovery, and battery recycling.
 



 As EWRI continues to scale, we are investing in technology\-driven traceability, automation, operational visibility, and customer reporting across the entire IT asset disposition process.
 


 About the Role
 
  





 EWRI is looking for an experienced
 **CRM \& Business Systems Architect** 
 to help us design the digital foundation for our next stage of growth.
 



 This is a business\-process and solution\-architecture role. We have
 **not pre\-selected a CRM or technology platform** 
 . The successful candidate will work directly with management and internal teams to understand how our business operates, map current and future requirements, evaluate suitable technology platforms, and recommend the right architecture for EWRI.
 



 The initial focus will be designing and implementing a scalable CRM covering sales, customer relationships, business development, international partnerships, direct outreach, asset sourcing, and auction opportunities.
 



 The system will subsequently need to integrate with or expand into ITAD project management, pickups and logistics, asset tracking, data security, inventory, refurbishment, remarketing, recycling, reporting, field operations, and customer\-facing portals.
 



 The objective is to create a connected business operating platform rather than implement a standalone CRM.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
  




* Work directly with management and internal teams to understand, map, and document existing business processes.
* Conduct structured requirements\-gathering sessions across sales, operations, logistics, finance, warehouse, ITAD, and management teams.
* Map current\-state workflows and design scalable future\-state processes.
* Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, duplicated data, and opportunities for automation.
* Define the functional and technical requirements for EWRI's CRM.
* Design workflows for accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, direct outreach, quotations, follow\-ups, approvals, partner management, and customer relationships.
* Design requirements for international ITAD partner development and onboarding.
* Design workflows for direct asset sourcing, supplier opportunities, inventory offers, and auction tracking.
* Evaluate suitable CRM, ERP, low\-code, and business application platforms based on EWRI's requirements.
* Compare platforms based on functionality, scalability, customization, integration capabilities, security, user experience, implementation complexity, and total cost of ownership.
* Recommend the appropriate technology stack and implementation architecture.
* Design the integration between CRM and future ITAD operational systems.
* Define data structures, workflows, automation rules, user roles, permissions, audit trails, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Develop detailed functional specifications and implementation documentation.
* Work closely with developers and/or implementation partners during development.
* Review development to ensure the system aligns with approved business processes and architecture.
* Lead or support UAT, deployment planning, employee training, and user adoption.
* Establish a long\-term roadmap for extending the platform into ITAD operations and other business functions.


 Future System Scope
 
  





 The architecture should be capable of supporting future modules including:
 


* ITAD project and site management
* Pickup and logistics management
* Asset and serial\-number tracking
* Data sanitization and destruction
* Field technician/mobile workflows
* Chain\-of\-custody tracking
* Exception management
* Automated reports and certificates
* Warehouse and inventory management
* Refurbishment and grading
* Asset recovery and remarketing
* Recycling and downstream tracking
* Customer and international partner portals
* Financial reconciliation and project profitability
* Management dashboards and business intelligence


 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  




* CRM and/or ERP solution architecture
* Business process mapping and process redesign
* Requirements gathering and functional specification
* CRM implementation and configuration
* Data architecture and workflow design
* Business process automation
* API and third\-party integrations
* User roles, permissions, security, and governance
* Reporting, dashboards, and business intelligence
* UAT, deployment, and user adoption
* Experience working directly with business users and senior management
* Experience taking business applications from discovery through implementation



 Experience with multiple platforms such as
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Salesforce, Odoo, Zoho, HubSpot, SAP, or similar enterprise business systems** 
 will be highly valued.
 



 The candidate should be capable of evaluating technologies objectively rather than being dependent on a single platform.
 


 What We're Looking For
 
  





 We are looking for someone who thinks
 **business process first and software second** 
 .
 



 The successful candidate should be comfortable sitting with our teams and observing how work actually happens — from a customer enquiry or outbound approach through quotation, project execution, asset processing, reporting, and commercial closure.
 



 We want someone capable of asking the right questions, challenging inefficient processes, identifying what should and should not be automated, and translating the resulting requirements into a scalable system architecture.
 



 The ideal candidate has previously been involved in the complete lifecycle:
 



**Business Discovery → Process Mapping → Requirements Gathering → Platform Evaluation → Solution Architecture → Implementation → Testing/UAT → Deployment → User Adoption → Continuous Improvement** 




**Experience: 3\+ years preferred.** 



 Initial Assignment
 
  





 The first phase will be to:
 


1. Understand and document EWRI's existing processes.
2. Define our future\-state workflows.
3. Develop detailed CRM requirements.
4. Evaluate suitable technology platforms.
5. Recommend the appropriate platform and architecture.
6. Define implementation costs, resources, risks, and timeline.
7. Develop a phased implementation roadmap.
8. Support the implementation of the selected solution.



 This is an opportunity to help design a business operating platform from the ground up and play a key role in EWRI's long\-term digital transformation as we scale our ITAD, refurbishment, recycling, and technology lifecycle operations across India and internationally.

title: ET BMC - MarTech Solution Architect
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Discipline:** 
 Brand, Marketing and Communications (BMC)
   

  

**Role Type:** 
 ET BMC \- MarTech Solution Architect
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The BMC MarTech Solution Architect plays a pivotal role in defining and enabling the future of BMC's digital, data and marketing technology ecosystem. This role is part of the Enterprise Technology CBS Solutions Delivery Team and partners closely with Product Managers in Technology Enablement and cross\-functional business teams such as Clients \& Industries (C\&I), Talent, Alumni and Communications.
   

  

 The architect is responsible for translating business strategy into target\-state architecture, defining the practical transition states required to reach it, and helping leadership and Product Managers convert that direction into prioritized, executable delivery roadmaps. The role brings together business, application, data, integration and technology perspectives to guide investment decisions and enable a scalable, data\-driven and AI\-enabled future.
   

  

 The role will also shape the future architecture of BMC's AI\-enabled MarTech ecosystem, defining how enterprise platforms, data, AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services and emerging technologies work together securely and at scale to deliver business value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Own and maintain the BMC MarTech architecture strategy, vision and target\-state architecture.
* Develop future\-state business, capability, application, data, integration and technology architectures aligned to business priorities and enterprise standards.
* Assess the current landscape and define transition\-state architectures, capability increments and migration approaches required to reach the target state.
* Partner with Product Managers and business leaders to translate architecture into phased multi\-year delivery roadmaps, investment plans and measurable business outcomes.
* Identify cross\-product dependencies, sequencing requirements, constraints, technical debt and transformation risks, and ensure these are reflected in delivery planning.
* Produce capability maps, architecture blueprints, heat maps, maturity assessments, integration views and transformation roadmaps that support clear decision\-making.
* Translate strategic business needs into end\-to\-end solution options and recommendations, including benefits, costs, risks, compliance, technical debt and long\-term sustainability.
* Advise senior leadership on technology strategy, platform evolution, investment priorities, sourcing choices and the implications of architecture decisions.
* Define and maintain MarTech architectural principles, standards, reusable patterns and reference architectures.
* Define architectural patterns for AI agents, agent orchestration, MCP\-enabled integrations and emerging digital worker capabilities across the MarTech ecosystem.
* Assess emerging technologies, including agentic AI, MCP frameworks, orchestration platforms and autonomous workflow capabilities, and determine their applicability to BMC business outcomes.
* Define the governance, security, identity, observability and interoperability patterns required to support AI\-enabled products and services at enterprise scale.
* Act as the architectural connector across BMC, ET, C\&I, Talent, Alumni and Communications, ensuring alignment across products, programmes and business functions.
* Reduce duplication and complexity by promoting reuse of enterprise platforms, shared capabilities, common data and agreed standards.
* Collaborate with Data Architecture teams to define AI\-ready data models, taxonomies, metadata structures and information flows.
* Ensure MarTech platforms integrate effectively with enterprise data lakes, CDPs, analytics platforms, identity services and consent capabilities.
* Assess emerging technologies and evaluate platform and vendor options with Product Management teams.
* Support business cases, portfolio prioritisation, design assurance and enterprise governance forums.
* Promote API\-first, event\-driven, modular and composable architecture principles.
* Champion security, privacy, accessibility, performance, resilience, observability and global scalability throughout the product lifecycle.
* Communicate complex architectural concepts and trade\-offs in clear, business\-focused language for executive, product and delivery audiences.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on MarTech strategy, transformation, innovation and platform evolution.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Deep knowledge of MarTech ecosystems, including CRM, CDP, CMS, DAM, marketing automation, analytics, identity and consent.
* Strong architecture modelling capabilities across business, capability, data, application, integration and technology domains.
* Proven experience producing current\-state assessments, target\-state architectures, transition\-state designs and migration strategies.
* Experience developing multi\-year transformation roadmaps and working with Product Managers to convert architectural direction into sequenced delivery plans.
* Ability to translate executive objectives and business outcomes into actionable architecture, investment priorities and delivery roadmaps.
* Experience leading architecture across complex transformation programmes involving multiple platforms, products and business functions.
* Knowledge of emerging AI architecture patterns, including agentic systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), orchestration frameworks, retrieval architectures and AI governance.
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and translating innovation opportunities into pragmatic architecture and product roadmaps.
* Strong commercial and strategic thinking, with experience supporting business cases, option assessments, vendor evaluations and investment decisions.
* Experience designing integrations across multiple enterprise platforms and data ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data strategy, data governance, privacy, security and AI enablement.
* Excellent communication, leadership, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders.
* Architecture certification such as TOGAF, ArchiMate or equivalent, with relevant cloud certification desirable.
* Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud, MS Dynamics, CDPs, DAM or comparable enterprise platforms.


**Typical architecture outputs**
* Current\-state and target\-state architecture views.
* Transition\-state architecture and migration approaches.
* Business capability maps, maturity assessments and heat maps.
* Multi\-year architecture and technology transformation roadmaps.
* Solution blueprints, integration architectures and data flow models.
* AI agent, orchestration and MCP\-enabled integration architecture patterns.
* Architecture principles, standards, reusable patterns and reference architectures.
* Solution option assessments, architecture decision records and investment recommendations.
* Dependency, risk, technical debt and sequencing views that support portfolio and product planning.


**Technologies and Tools**
* MarTech and AdTech platforms, including Adobe and demand\-side platforms.
* CDP, CMS, CRM, DAM, marketing automation and analytics platforms, including Adobe, MS Dynamics and Microsoft Azure ecosystems.
* AI and agentic platforms, orchestration frameworks, retrieval services and enterprise knowledge platforms.
* MCP\-enabled integration patterns and services.
* API\-led, ESB, event\-driven and composable integration approaches.
* Cloud platforms, including Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Architecture and modelling tools, including LeanIX, ArchiMate and Lucidchart.


**What We Offer**
 We offer the opportunity to shape the future of BMC’s enterprise technology landscape, with significant influence across ET, C\&I, Talent, Alumni, and Communications. You will collaborate with global teams, drive architectural standards, and help build an AI\-enabled future through strong partnership with Data Architecture.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the skills and capabilities needed to thrive in a rapidly evolving digital and AI environment.
* Success, as defined by you: We empower you with tools, flexibility, and support to make a meaningful impact.
* Transformative leadership: You’ll receive coaching, enablement, and opportunities to lead strategic technology decisions that impact the global organisation.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be valued for your perspective and empowered to help shape a culture of innovation and inclusion.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Solution Architect
description:
About Vorro
 



 Vorro is an enterprise data integration company and the creator of the BridgeGate Enterprise Integration Platform as a Service (EiPaaS). BridgeGate uses a patented any\-to\-any integration technology, with visual mapping and workflow orchestration, to connect applications, business processes and external trading partners without the cost of custom interface development.
 



 Vorro has been deployed in over 100 enterprise environments across healthcare, retail, insurance, logistics and specialty networks, with particular depth in healthcare, where BridgeGate helps payers, providers, EMR vendors, HIEs and pharmacies exchange clinical and financial data using standards such as HL7, CCD/CCDA and FHIR. Alongside the platform, Vorro offers fully managed integration services, taking ownership of data interfacing and partner coordination on customers’ behalf.
 



 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for a Solution Architect to own the technical design and solution roadmap for Vorro customer engagements built on BridgeGate. This is a customer\-facing role: you will translate multi\-system integration requirements into clear architectures, define phased implementation roadmaps, and govern delivery against them from discovery through production rollout.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**Solution Architecture and Design** 



* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture for integration engagements on BridgeGate, covering integration patterns, data flow, interface design, security and scalability.
* Run discovery workshops to capture business processes, source and target systems, data formats and compliance needs, and convert these into documented technical requirements.
* Design any\-to\-any integration solutions across applications, EMRs, HIEs, payer systems, trading partners and internal enterprise systems, defining the data mapping and transformation logic involved.
* Produce and maintain solution design documents, interface specifications and data flow diagrams, and design for throughput, availability, error handling and monitoring.



**Solution Roadmapping** 



* Build robust, phased solution roadmaps for each engagement, covering current state, target state, milestones, dependencies and sequencing.
* Maintain and revise the roadmap through the engagement as scope or priorities shift, and run regular checkpoints with customer and internal leadership on progress.
* Define migration roadmaps for customers moving off legacy interface engines onto BridgeGate, and scalability roadmaps so delivered solutions can absorb new partners and volumes without re\-architecture.
* Feed capability gaps identified in customer roadmaps back to Product and Engineering.



**Pre\-Sales and Customer Engagement** 



* Support sales with technical discovery, solution positioning, architecture walkthroughs and proof of concept.
* Contribute solution design, estimates and delivery roadmap to RFPs, proposals and statements of work.
* Act as trusted technical advisor to customer stakeholders, from integration analysts to CIOs.



**Delivery Governance** 



* Govern implementation against the approved architecture and roadmap through design reviews and go\-live readiness checks.
* Provide technical guidance to integration developers and support engineers through build, testing and deployment.
* Lead resolution of escalated technical issues in production\-critical integrations, and ensure solutions meet security, compliance and audit requirements.



 Required Qualifications and Skills
 


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or a related field.
* 7 to 10 years of total IT experience, including at least 2 years in a Solution Architect, Technical Architect or Integration Architect capacity.
* Hands\-on background with integration platforms, interface engines, ESB or iPaaS technologies, and API design.
* Working knowledge of data formats and protocols: XML, JSON, EDI, flat file, REST, SOAP, SFTP and messaging systems.
* Demonstrated experience building and owning solution roadmaps, including phasing, milestones and stakeholder alignment.
* Strong data mapping and transformation expertise across systems with no common standard.
* Good understanding of cloud/hybrid deployment, and experience designing for security and compliance in regulated environments.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work directly with customers in a pre\-sales or delivery capacity.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience with healthcare interoperability standards: HL7 v2, CCD/CCDA, FHIR, X12 EDI.
* Experience integrating EMR, EHR, HIE, pharmacy or payer systems, and familiarity with HIPAA requirements.
* Cloud or architecture certifications such as AWS, Azure or TOGAF.
* Experience working with US\-based customers and partial overlap with US time zones.



 What We Offer
 


* Ownership of the architecture and roadmap for enterprise integration programmes with measurable business impact.
* Exposure to a patented integration platform and complex, standards\-driven interoperability problems.
* Direct engagement with senior customer stakeholders and a path to principal or practice leadership roles.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 As a Senior Cyber AI Engineer within EY's Global Delivery Services (GDS) Cybersecurity Team, you will drive the convergence of Cybersecurity, Vulnerability Management, and Artificial Intelligence to build intelligent, scalable, and automated security operations.
   

  

 You will design, implement, and enhance AI\-enabled vulnerability management programs that leverage machine learning, generative AI, intelligent analytics, and automation to improve risk identification, prioritization, remediation, and executive decision\-making across enterprise environments.
   

  

 In addition to delivering client engagements, you will help shape EY’s AI\-driven Cybersecurity capabilities, contribute to thought leadership, and mentor teams on applying AI responsibly and securely within cyber operations.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As organizations rapidly adopt AI and cloud\-native technologies, cybersecurity teams must evolve beyond traditional vulnerability management approaches. You will help clients transform their security operations by applying AI and data\-driven techniques to vulnerability management lifecycle
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 AI Security \& Guardrails
   

  

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise AI security guardrails.
* Develop controls to mitigate prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, model abuse, and adversarial attacks.
* Define AI trust, safety, governance, and security standards.
* Evaluate AI applications against organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Establish policies and enforcement mechanisms for responsible AI usage.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for AI applications, agents, and autonomous workflows.
* Define secure deployment patterns for LLM, RAG, and agent\-based solutions.
* Establish security logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities for AI systems.


 AI Red Teaming
   

  

* Conduct AI red team assessments against enterprise AI applications.
* Develop adversarial testing scenarios and attack simulations.
* Identify and document vulnerabilities and weaknesses within AI systems.
* Perform threat modeling for AI\-enabled business processes.
* Define remediation recommendations and compensating controls.
* Perform AI\-focused penetration testing against LLM, RAG, and agentic applications.
* Assess risks related to prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, tool manipulation, excessive agency, data poisoning, and model abuse.
* Execute threat\-informed adversarial simulations aligned to MITRE ATLAS and OWASP LLM guidance.


 Engineering \& Automation
   

  

* Develop Python\-based automation for AI security and testing workflows.
* Build APIs, integrations, and orchestration frameworks supporting AI evaluation efforts.
* Integrate testing and governance controls into CI/CD pipelines.
* Create dashboards and reporting capabilities that provide visibility into AI risk and performance.
* Integrate AI security controls into DevSecOps and Secure SDLC processes.
* Automate security validation, compliance verification, and security regression testing for AI applications.


**Additional AI Security Skills**
* Application Security (OWASP Top 10\)
* Secure SDLC / DevSecOps
* Penetration Testing and Red Teaming
* Security Architecture Reviews
* Cloud Security
* Identity and Access Management
* Threat Detection and Monitoring
* Vulnerability Management


 Additional Security Frameworks
   

  

* MITRE ATLAS
* OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
* OWASP ASVS
* NIST AI Risk Management Framework
* NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
* Secure AI Development and Governance Frameworks


**To Qualify for the Role**
**Education**
* BE / BTech / MTech / MSc / MCA


**Experience**
* 4–8 years in Cybersecurity
* 2\+ years working with AI/ML or Security Automation initiatives
* Experience leading enterprise Vulnerability Management programs


**Preferred Certifications**
* CEH, CISSP, CISM, OSCP, GIAC, Azure AI, Open AI, AWS ML, Azure ML certifications


**What We Look For**
**Professionals who can bridge the gap between cybersecurity and artificial intelligence by:**
* Building AI\-enabled cyber defense solutions.
* Automating vulnerability and risk management processes.
* Driving next\-generation cyber transformation initiatives.


 The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a Security Architect, Vulnerability Management Leader and AI Engineer to create intelligent, scalable, and resilient cybersecurity VM programs.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits**

 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk\-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk\-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks \& providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
   

  

 Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit \& Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
   

  

**Role Summary/ Purpose**
 The
 **eGRC Solution Architect** 
 is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk \& Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that
 **automate, standardize, and integrate** 
 governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end\-to\-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and deliver GRC solutions:  Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end\-to\-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions.
* Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology\-based solutions .
* Lead technical implementations :  Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms.
* Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
* Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's Degree and 10 \+years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12\+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience
* Deep GRC domain knowledge: Strong understanding of GRC concepts and core processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments) and how they align to risk and control objectives .
* GRC platform expertise : 5\+ years of hands\-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 .
* Solution architecture experience: 5\+ years designing and delivering end\-to\-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target\-state architecture, standards, and non\-functional requirements.
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills: Proven ability to assess business needs, evaluate risk and control impacts, identify trade\-offs, and design scalable solutions that meet functional requirements.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Architectural and technical skills:  Proficiency in designing complex systems, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise integration via APIs and data pipelines.
* Communication and stakeholder management: The ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership.


**Eligibility Criteria**

title: Cloud Security Architect
description:
**Job Summary**
 Minfy Tech is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Cloud Security Architect to join our team. In this role, you will be a critical leader in helping our customers migrate their on\-premise environments to AWS while transforming and enhancing their security posture. Your primary responsibility will be to analyze our customers' existing IT landscapes, understand their security and network architectures, and design secure and scalable AWS solutions. You will be instrumental in helping customers modernize their security infrastructure, including migrating from legacy firewalls to advanced VM\-series firewalls and adopting SD\-WAN technologies.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Security Architecture Design:
* Assess customers' existing security and network architectures in on\-premise environments.
* Design secure, scalable, and cost\-effective AWS cloud solutions aligned with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Develop detailed security architecture diagrams, documentation, and migration plans.
* Recommend and implement security enhancements and transformations, such as moving to VM\-series firewalls and SD\-WAN.
* Cloud Security Implementation:
* Configure and deploy AWS security services (e.g., IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, VPCs, Security Groups, NACLs) to protect workloads in the cloud.
* Implement and manage security infrastructure, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and web application firewalls (WAFs).
* Automate security configuration and deployment using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like CloudFormation or Terraform.
* Security Transformation:
* Lead the transformation of customers' security posture from traditional models to modern, cloud\-centric approaches.
* Provide expertise in migrating from port\-based firewalls to advanced VM\-series firewalls and implementing SD\-WAN technologies.
* Design and implement network segmentation strategies to isolate workloads and minimize the attack surface.
* Risk Management and Compliance:
* Conduct risk assessments and vulnerability analyses to identify security gaps in the cloud environment.
* Develop and implement security policies, standards, and procedures to ensure compliance with industry regulations (e.g., HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR).
* Participate in security audits and compliance reviews.
* Collaboration and Communication:
* Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams, including cloud engineers, developers, and project managers.
* Communicate security requirements and best practices to stakeholders at all levels.
* Provide security training and mentorship to other team members.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in security architecture, with a focus on cloud security and AWS.
* Strong understanding of network and security architectures in on\-premise environments.
* Deep expertise in AWS security services and best practices.
* Experience designing and implementing security solutions for cloud migration projects.
* Knowledge of security frameworks and standards (e.g., NIST, CIS, ISO 27001\).
* Familiarity with security tools and technologies, such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and SIEM solutions.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation tools (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform).
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty or equivalent certification is highly preferred.
* Experience migrating from traditional firewalls to VM\-series firewalls and implementing SD\-WAN solutions.
* Experience with cloud security automation tools.
* Experience working with enterprise customers.

**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
   

  

 Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
